report.title: Tags with & in them are now broken (won't display correctly) and can no longher be created
report.body: ### Pre-submission Checklist - [x] I have searched the existing issues and this bug has not been reported yet - [x] I have tested this issue on the [demo site](https://demo.usememos.com) or the latest version ### Where did you encounter this bug? Latest stable version (self-hosted) ### Memos Version v0.26.1 ### Bug Description I can't test it on the demo site because it is now the new version. I don't know when this broke/changed - it might not be the most recent version, on mobile which I use normally it is less obvious, I noticed it today as I used the desktop version and it stood out far more! In previous versions it was possible to have tags / labels with & in them (maybe other characters, but I only used &), making a new tag by typing (without quotes) "#science&tech" would make a tag that included the whole string. I have that label in my Memos instance, and can add it still via the drop-down menu. However, since the recent release, any post that contains that label is rendered as "#science"&tech - where the parts in quotes are the tag, and the &tech is just adjacent text. If I try and add a new tag with an &,. it won't let me - it will just create a new tag "#science" which I don;t want/need. In short, it seems that a) new version doesn't allow & in labels and b)backwards compatibility is broken ### Steps to Reproduce On older version make a label containing an &. It works fine, and as any other label. Upgrade to new version, repeat the steps and it wont let you make such a label. On new version, look at posts with that label - they display incorrectly ### Expected Behavior I expect to be able to make labels with & in them like I used to be able to. The label name should end on white-space. OR tell me this limitation in the UI. ### Screenshots & Additional Context

preconditions: the app is on version v0.26.1 or similar recent release
steps: Click the memo editor input on the home page
Click the Save button to create the memo
Look at the newly created memo in the memo list
plan.expected: the saved memo shows a single tag "#science&tech" with the whole string, including "&tech", rendered as part of the tag
plan.reported_actual: The memo renders only "#science" as the tag, and "&tech" appears as plain adjacent text. A new tag "#science" is created instead of "#science&tech".
missing: assumed: the memo content is only the text "#science&tech" with no other text
assumed: the tag is checked in the rendered memo list rather than the editor's tag dropdown
Which exact version introduced the regression?
Does the issue also occur with other special characters besides &?
plan.summary: Tags containing & are cut off at the & when rendered, so "#science&tech" becomes tag "#science"
